character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: dark auburn hair in a practical sailor braid, sea-green eyes, with a clearly recognizable face and stable adult proportions. They are a harbor radio operator who greets the fishing boats at first light. Signature clothing: a navy peacoat over a striped cream shirt, rust-red scarf, and deck shoes. Defining personal object: a brass harbor whistle attached to a braided lanyard. Keep the same facial structure, hairstyle, hair and eye colors, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use one fixed protagonist identity throughout this theme's entire music video.
Preserve the same recognizable face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, key materials, colors, and defining personal object unchanged.
Do not replace the protagonist or add another lead unless the lyrics explicitly call for one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in fishing harbor at sunrise, morning fish market, breakwater with a lighthouse; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with sea blue, buoy orange, rust red, morning pink; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide shot of a harbor at sunrise, low tracking along a quay of crates, close-up of ropes and rust; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
